title: Adapter protocol: static-deps + fingerprint commands
description:
## Phase 2 of adapter protocol

Follow-on from testaruda-9uw (discover flow). Implements:
- `static-deps` command: return candidate tests, K-valued edges, unresolved files (TIA-ADAPT-005)
- Per-symbol edges when `symbol_model_complete` is true
- `fingerprint` command: return content fingerprints at declared granularity (TIA-ADAPT-006)
- Semiring edge values defaulting to multiplicative identity (TIA-ADAPT-009)

Spec: `openspec/specs/adapter-protocol/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/static-dependency-analysis.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/content-fingerprinting.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/default-semiring-weight.toml`

title: Implement CI exit codes and shadow mode (TIA-CI-001..008)
description:
Implement correct CI exit codes (0=success, 10=full-run, 20=empty, other=error), shadow mode (compute but report all-tests), machine-readable JSON plan output, and CI result ingestion.

Depends on deterministic ordering (testaruda-x1i) for stable JSON output.

Spec: `openspec/specs/ci-integration/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/ci-integration/*.toml` (8 contracts)
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] `testaruda select` exits with 0 on success
- [x] Confidence below threshold → exit 10
- [x] Empty selection set → exit 20
- [x] Hard error → non-zero distinct from 10/20
- [x] `--shadow` flag computes selection but signals full run
- [x] `--json` flag emits machine-readable plan
- [x] `testaruda ingest` updates model from CI results

title: Implement adapter protocol subprocess management (TIA-ADAPT-001..013)
description:
## Phase 1: End-to-end adapter discover flow (this issue)

HITL: Confirm JSON schema for handshake/discover/static-deps commands before implementation (ref: TIA-ADAPT-001 format, spec Appendix C).

Implement the first end-to-end tracer bullet through the adapter protocol:
- Spawn adapter subprocess with least privilege and timeout (TIA-ADAPT-013)
- JSON request/response over stdin/stdout (TIA-ADAPT-001)
- Handshake: parse name, version, protocol, capabilities (TIA-ADAPT-002)
- `discover` command: enumerate test items (TIA-ADAPT-004)
- Store discovered items in the store
- Graceful degradation for missing capabilities (TIA-ADAPT-010)
- Protocol version check (TIA-ADAPT-011)
- Fallback on adapter failure (TIA-ADAPT-012)

Spec: `openspec/specs/adapter-protocol/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/adapter-communication.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/handshake-response.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/test-discovery.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/adapter-sandboxing.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/version-mismatch.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/adapter-timeout.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/missing-capability.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Adapter subprocess spawns with timeout and resource limits
- [x] Handshake returns name, version, protocol, capabilities
- [x] Protocol version mismatch → adapter rejected with diagnostic
- [x] Adapter timeout → fallback triggers for component
- [x] Missing capability → core degrades gracefully with conservative default
- [x] `discover` enumerates test items stored in DB
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement content fingerprinting (TIA-CHG-003, TIA-CORE-002)
description:
The store records fingerprints for content units but uses placeholder 'unknown' fingerprints. Implement proper blake3 content fingerprinting for changed-file detection.

- Compute blake3 hash from normalized file content
- Update fingerprint on file changes
- Compare fingerprints to determine change set (TIA-CHG-003)
- Store fingerprint in content_units table (TIA-CORE-002)

Spec: `openspec/specs/change-detection/spec.md`, `openspec/specs/core-data-model/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/change-detection/fingerprint-comparison.toml`, `.espectacular/core-data-model/fingerprint-storage.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] `cargo test` passes
- [x] Store records blake3 hash for new content units
- [x] Changed-file detection returns correct Δ for modified files
- [x] Unchanged files produce empty Δ
- [x] Corresponding espectacular contracts transition from no-tests-ran to pass

title: Agent output format (TIA-AGENT-001..007)
description:
Depends on deterministic ordering (testaruda-x1i) for byte-stable JSON output.

Implement structured JSON agent output for LLM coding agent consumption:
- Structured JSON: selection, per-test reasons, confidence, changed units, summary stats (TIA-AGENT-001)
- Byte-stable output (via deterministic ordering dependency) (TIA-AGENT-002)
- Reason chains for selected tests, exclusion reasons for skipped (TIA-AGENT-003)
- Specific test query: why selected or not (TIA-AGENT-004)
- Pre-edit blast radius: report affected tests without applying edit (TIA-AGENT-005)
- Coverage gap surfacing: changed symbol with no covering test (TIA-AGENT-006)
- Default deterministic for agent/gate mode (TIA-AGENT-007)

Spec: `openspec/specs/agent-mode/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/agent-mode/*.toml` (7 contracts)

title: Adapter protocol: run-args + ingest commands
description:
## Phase 3 of adapter protocol

Follow-on from testaruda-9uw (discover) and testaruda-???? (static-deps). Implements:
- `run-args` command: return native runner argv + collection path, no test execution (TIA-ADAPT-007)
- `ingest` command: return runtime edges, per-test results, external inputs (TIA-ADAPT-008)

Spec: `openspec/specs/adapter-protocol/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/run-arguments-generation.toml`, `.espectacular/adapter-protocol/run-output-ingestion.toml`

title: Implement schema migration (TIA-STORE-004)
description:
Store schema version tracking and migration. When schema version differs from running core, migrate or refuse with clear diagnostic. Version the store schema.

Runs in parallel with most other issues (store initialization only).

Spec: `openspec/specs/persistence/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/persistence/schema-version-mismatch.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Store schema versioned and tracked on init
- [x] Version mismatch triggers migration or clear diagnostic
- [x] No data corruption on migration
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Write core unit tests for store, engine, CLI
description: Expand test coverage from 6 tests to cover the core data model operations, edge cases, CLI commands, and error paths. Each test should map to a spect contract scenario.
close_reason: Folded into feature issues. Each feature issue now includes acceptance criteria with explicit test expectations. Test writing is part of the definition of done for every feature, not a separate catch-all task. The 3 existing contracts with targeted cargo test commands serve as the pattern to follow.

title: Write seeded-fault recall tests (TIA-VER-004)
description:
Implement the seeded-fault recall test: seed regressions with known fault-revealing tests, verify every such test is selected. This is the verification gate for the soundness invariant (TIA-SAFE-001).

Spec: `openspec/specs/verification/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/verification/seeded-fault-evaluation.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] For each seeded regression, the fault-revealing test is selected
- [x] Any missed selection recorded as soundness violation
- [x] Test implements the documented pattern from Appendix G worked example
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement provenance persistence and explain command (TIA-PROV-005, TIA-PROV-004)
description:
Persist provenance such that past selections can be re-explained without re-running. Wire the explain command to return reason chains for selected tests and exclusion reasons for skipped tests.

Blocks deterministic ordering (testaruda-x1i) since explain output should be stable.

Spec: `openspec/specs/provenance/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/provenance/provenance-per-test.toml`, `.espectacular/provenance/reason-chain-output.toml`, `.espectacular/provenance/exclusion-explanation.toml`, `.espectacular/provenance/explain-endpoint.toml`, `.espectacular/provenance/historical-explanation.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Provenance persisted with each selection
- [x] Past selection re-explainable without re-running
- [x] `testaruda explain <id>` returns reason chain for selected tests
- [x] `testaruda explain <id>` returns exclusion reason for skipped tests
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement component cache for incremental selection (TIA-COMP-010)
description:
Implement content-addressed component caching: key cached selection decisions on dependency fingerprint, reuse when fingerprint unchanged. Support local-then-remote cache lookup (TIA-COMP-011).

Depends on content fingerprinting (testaruda-imo) for cache keys.

Spec: `openspec/specs/composability/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/composability/cache-reuse.toml`, `.espectacular/composability/remote-cache-lookup.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Component cache keyed on dependency fingerprint
- [x] Unchanged dependency fingerprint → cached decision reused
- [x] Changed dependency fingerprint → cache invalidated
- [x] `cargo test` passes for all cache paths

title: Implement idempotent ingestion with run-identity key (TIA-RUN-005)
description:
Implement run-identity key dedup: check for existing key before writes, reject payloads without a key, wrap ingestion in a single transaction for crash safety (TIA-REL-002).

Spec: `openspec/specs/runtime-feedback/spec.md`, `openspec/specs/non-functional/spec.md` (REL section)
Contracts: `.espectacular/runtime-feedback/duplicate-ingestion-skipped.toml`, `.espectacular/runtime-feedback/missing-run-identity-key-rejection.toml`, `.espectacular/non-functional/crash-during-ingestion.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Payload with already-recorded run-identity key → ingestion skipped
- [x] Payload without run-identity key → rejected with diagnostic
- [x] Crash during ingestion → store in pre-ingestion state
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement always-run set completeness (TIA-SAFE-007)
description:
Extend always-run set to include all categories: previously-failed tests (done), newly-added tests, tests with no recorded history, and quarantined tests. Implement quarantine semantics (TIA-SAFE-010): selected-and-run but excluded from pass/fail trust.

Depends on content fingerprinting (testaruda-imo) for detecting newly-added tests, and component cache (testaruda-4z8) so always-run markers propagate correctly.

Spec: `openspec/specs/safety/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/safety/always-run-composition.toml`, `.espectacular/safety/quarantined-test-run.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Previously-failed, newly-added, no-history, and quarantined tests all in always-run set
- [x] Quarantined test runs but its outcome excluded from pass/fail trust
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement deterministic ordering and agent output (TIA-SEL-005, TIA-AGENT-001..007)
description:
## Part 1: Deterministic selection ordering (this issue)

Implement stable, reproducible ordering of affected test sets. This is the prerequisite for agent output format and CI exit codes.

- Byte-stable output for identical inputs and store state (TIA-SEL-005)
- Default deterministic mode for agent/gate use (TIA-AGENT-007)
- Duration ordering option: descending by recorded mean duration (TIA-SEL-006)
- Predictive ranking constraints: order-only, never remove always-run members (TIA-SEL-007)

Blocks: testaruda-gbs (CI exit codes need stable output)
Blocks: agent output format issue

Spec: `openspec/specs/selection-engine/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/selection-engine/stable-ordering.toml`, `.espectacular/selection-engine/duration-based-sort.toml`, `.espectacular/selection-engine/ranking-preserves-recall.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Identical inputs + store state → byte-identical output
- [x] Duration ordering sorts by descending mean duration
- [x] Predictive ranking re-orders only, never removes always-run
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement confidence floor and gating (TIA-CONF-002, TIA-SAFE-002..003)
description:
Implement the per-invocation confidence floor from coverage freshness, adapter resolution, history depth, and environment match. Wire confidence threshold to component-scoped fallback selecting all tests when below threshold.

Note: Fallback is scoped per affected component. Always-run-only components skip fallback (TIA-SAFE-002 second clause). Depends on adapter protocol (testaruda-9uw) for adapter resolution ratio.

Spec: `openspec/specs/confidence-scoring/spec.md`, `openspec/specs/safety/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/confidence-scoring/*.toml` (4 contracts), `.espectacular/safety/confidence-below-threshold.toml`, `.espectacular/safety/component-scoped-fallback.toml`, `.espectacular/safety/always-run-only-component.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Coverage freshness, adapter resolution, history depth, environment match all factored into confidence
- [x] Confidence below threshold → component-scoped full run fallback
- [x] Always-run-only component → no fallback triggered
- [x] Stored edge weights unchanged by invocation-level signals
- [x] Confidence reported in all consumer output formats
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement missed-selection incident recording (TIA-SAFE-008)
description:
When a full run fails a test that selection would have skipped, record a missed-selection incident and create a manual edge forcing the test on the implicated change in future.

Spec: `openspec/specs/safety/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/safety/missed-selection-recording.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Full run failure that selection skipped → incident recorded
- [x] Manual edge created forcing the test on the implicated change
- [x] Missed-selection count exposed via metrics (TIA-OBS-003)
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement user-defined must-run rules and periodic full-run (TIA-SAFE-006, TIA-SAFE-009)
description:
Implement config-driven forced selection rules covering two mechanisms:
1. Must-run rules (TIA-SAFE-009): path globs mapped to tests, force-select when matching files change.
2. Periodic full-run (TIA-SAFE-006): configurable schedule independent of change-based selection.

Spec: `openspec/specs/safety/spec.md`
Contracts: `.espectacular/safety/must-run-pattern-match.toml`, `.espectacular/safety/periodic-full-run-configured.toml`
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Must-run glob patterns force-select mapped tests on matching file changes
- [x] Periodic full-run schedule selects all tests regardless of changes
- [x] Configuration in `testaruda.toml` or equivalent
- [x] `cargo test` passes

title: Implement Soufflé oracle bridge (TIA-ENG-010, TIA-ENG-011)
description:

Phase 2: Implement shadow-mode cross-check against Ascent results (TIA-ENG-011).

Requires `souffle` CLI on PATH for verification. On `testaruda init` detect presence and warn if missing.

- [x] Shadow mode cross-check flags Ascent/Soufflé divergences
- [x] `init` warns if souffle not found without failing
- [x] `cargo test` passes
